info.title: Códice API
info.description: Las reglas del SAT, citadas textualmente con su fuente y vigencia. Every response is `{ data, meta }`; errors are `application/problem+json`.

tags.name: Búsqueda
tags.description: Find rules by question or code.

tags.name: Registros
tags.description: Exact lookups: error codes, catalogs and sources.

get.description: Searches the SAT's rules in force on `asOf` by meaning and by exact code, and returns the matching passages verbatim with their source; `format=brief` returns each one's heading path and an excerpt instead.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The question or code, in Spanish or English, such as `CFDI40149` or `código postal del receptor con RFC genérico`.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Only rules in force on this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in Mexico City.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Only one kind of passage: `guia` for the filling guides, which define each field (ask what a field means with `guia`); `anexo` for the validation matrix; `regla` for the RMF reglas.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many passages to return; 5 by default.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `full` (the default) quotes each passage's matched text; `brief` gives its heading path and an excerpt of at most 320 characters around the question's words, cut from the text verbatim, for `/v1/passages/{id}` to read the one that answers.

passageId.description: Pass it to `/v1/passages/{id}` to read the whole passage.

quote.description: The matched text, verbatim as the SAT wrote it.

validFrom.description: First day the rule applies, YYYY-MM-DD.

validUntil.description: Last day it applies; null while in force.

passageId.description: Pass it to `/v1/passages/{id}` to read the whole passage.

excerpt.description: Up to about 300 characters of the matched text around the question's words, an exact substring of it.

truncated.description: Whether the matched text continues before or after the excerpt.

validFrom.description: First day the rule applies, YYYY-MM-DD.

validUntil.description: Last day it applies; null while in force.

401.description: Missing, unknown, revoked or expired API key.

429.description: Over 60 requests a minute for this key. Retry after `retry-after` seconds.

get.description: The whole passage a search result points to. The id holds a slash; send it plain or encoded (`%2F`).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The passage id a search result gives, `<source>/<anchor>.md`, such as `matriz-de-errores-cfdi-40/cfdi40149.md`.

text.description: The whole passage: its heading path, then the verbatim text.

validFrom.description: First day the rule applies, YYYY-MM-DD.

validUntil.description: Last day it applies; null while in force.

url.description: Where the SAT publishes the document.

sha256.description: Hash of the document Códice read, to check it against the original.

404.description: Nothing by that id, code or key.

get.description: A SAT catalog in the SAT's order, at most 500 entries. With `q`, a search of the catalog by description instead: the entries whose key or descriptions hold every word of `q` (or, when none does, the most of them), best first, from D1's full-text index.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The SAT catalog, such as `c_UsoCFDI` or `RegimenFiscal`; the `c_` prefix is optional.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words of the entry's description, accents optional, such as `servicios de consultoría` (c_ClaveProdServ), `kilogramo` (c_ClaveUnidad) or `gastos médicos` (c_UsoCFDI). A key matches too.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many entries to return; 10 by default.

200.description: The catalog; with `q`, the matching entries.

truncated.description: True when the catalog has more than the 500 entries returned.

url.description: Where the SAT publishes the document.

sha256.description: Hash of the document Códice read, to check it against the original.

entries.description: The matching entries, best first; empty when none matches.

get.description: Every entry of a key in a SAT catalog. Any other query parameter filters by a column, named as in the SAT's catalog (`?c_CodigoPostal=01000`).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The SAT catalog, such as `c_UsoCFDI` or `RegimenFiscal`; the `c_` prefix is optional.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The entry's key, such as `S01` or `601`.

url.description: Where the SAT publishes the document.

sha256.description: Hash of the document Códice read, to check it against the original.

401.description: Missing, unknown, revoked or expired API key.

404.description: Nothing by that id, code or key.

429.description: Over 60 requests a minute for this key. Retry after `retry-after` seconds.

get.description: The passages the SAT added, changed or removed from `since` through `until`, by the day each change applies from. The first version of a source Códice holds is where its history starts, not a change.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: The first day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD: changes that apply from this day on.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: The last day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD. Without it, every change from `since` on, including any Códice already holds for a later date.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only one source, by the id `list_sources` gives, such as `rmf-2026`.

change.description: `changed` with a null `previousPassageId` is a change Códice holds no earlier text of.

date.description: The day the change applies from, YYYY-MM-DD.

passageId.description: The text in force from `date`; for `removed`, the dated id of the last text. Read it with `/v1/passages/{id}`.

previousPassageId.description: For `changed`, the dated id of the text that applied until the day before.

validFrom.description: First day the rule applies, YYYY-MM-DD.

validUntil.description: Last day it applies; null while in force.
